intro: With the Bloodsail Buccaneers preparing an attack, Fleet Master Seahorn decides against deploying his entire fleet for a counterstrike. Instead, he directs an adventuring crew to slip into the landing site and eliminate the buccaneers' top leadership before their attack can begin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blast the nerve of Firallon! He couldn't sail a skiff through Crystal Lake let alone lead an entire fleet against us.
The Bloodsail Buccaneers will pay for their carelessness. Now that we know their plan of attack, we can counter before they know what hit them.

But why send the entire fleet to do the work of one brave adventuring party? Friend, take some of your most skilled comrades out to Firallon's landing spot and assassinate the Bloodsail leadership. Their fleet will sink soon after....

clips.title: Progress
paras: What's the problem, friend? We need to attack before the Bloodsail Buccaneers do!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, what a great day for the Blackwater Raiders! Three cheers to you, friend!
